card.name: Partway through spaced or foreign words
card.fires_on: Marked piece sits inside a word or number that is split up, such as letter-spaced drug names, romanized Chinese or Japanese terms, or the last digit of a number before a unit.

modes.label: Letter-spaced drug names
modes.description: Inside a drug class name written with spaces between letters.

modes.label: Romanized foreign terms
modes.description: Inside or just after pinyin, Spanish or Hebrew words given in a parenthetical gloss.

modes.label: Digits before a unit
modes.description: The last zero of a number just before a unit like ng/L or mOsmol/L.

card.writes: Promotes odd code-like and bracket tokens and suppresses broken byte tokens, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of oddly split words, foreign-language spellings and numbers, where the next piece is uncertain.
